correctness.rationale: The component profile in the source classification has cycle length k, depths with sizes k ell_j, and exactly k product(b_j!)^(k ell_j) automorphisms. A nonempty set of copies yields exp(z^s/a)-1; same-k exclusivity yields the product. Injective level-size encoding into integer partitions bounds all connected profile counts by p(m), giving finite upper generating majorant for every r<1. Permutations give u_n>=n!, so logarithmic n! growth is exactly zero; Stirling yields log(probability)/n -> -1. Exact rational EGF coefficients through n=12 agree with complete enumeration of all n^n maps for n<=6.

value.rationale: The recent classification provides structure but not labelled prevalence. The exact EGF is a global same-cycle-length constrained species census rather than an unweighted isomorphism count, and the partition-profile argument gives a sharp and nontrivial large-deviation exponent for a central model-theoretic extension property. This comparison distinguishes ultrahomogeneity quantitatively from similarly named polymorphism-homogeneity. No finer multiplicative asymptotics are asserted.
